name: Clairemont / Bay Park
notes: Trash and organics (green bin) are collected every week on Monday; recycling (blue bin) is collected every other week on the same day, and looking up your address tells you which weeks are yours. No collection on New Year's Day, Memorial Day, Labor Day, Thanksgiving, or Christmas; if a holiday falls on a weekday, that day's route and every remaining route that week shift one day later. The ZIP codes listed for this zone are a fictional demo mapping, not the City's real collection map: confirm your own day at getitdone.sandiego.gov/CollectionMapLookup.
